name: many-campaigns
about: Four campaigns, figures in the thousands, one with no lead.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 4 campaigns delivered 67 leads across 161,223 impressions at a cost per lead of $38.51.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the day's dominant campaign: $1,456.78 spent, 92,400 impressions, 1,310 clicks, 41 leads at $35.53 cost per lead and a 1.4% click rate.

Recent graduates was the second-largest lead source with 17 leads at $35.89 cost per lead, the lowest on the day alongside Joliet, on a 1.7% click rate — the highest click rate across all 4 campaigns.
Owner operators spent $124.50 and drew 51 clicks at a 0.7% click rate but produced no leads, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Dedicated night runs returned 9 leads at $43.22 cost per lead, the highest of any campaign, on a 1.2% click rate and $389.00 in spend.
Month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $12,534.06 with 28 days left in 2026-11.
The 2026-10-26 lead cohort is too young to judge: 12 leads so far, with 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — rates will be available once it matures.
